contract.causal_history_rule: history(t) = [t-3,t-2,t-1,t], left-padded by repeating the earliest frame

fields.name: changed_pixel_mask
fields.rationale: supervises the changed-probability head

fields.causal_availability: trivially available live as step * policy_dt
fields.name: control_timestamp
fields.rationale: excluded for the same reason as episode_step; it is an affine function of it

fields.causal_availability: available at t; the four-frame window [t-3..t] is reconstructed causally
fields.name: current_closeness
fields.rationale: the primary observation; the field the obstacle is visible in

fields.name: current_field_sha256
fields.rationale: provenance and leakage checks

fields.causal_availability: recomputable live from current_closeness through the frozen head
fields.name: current_head
fields.rationale: not privileged in principle -- it is a deterministic function of a deployable field -- but it is read as a stored target here, never as a model input
fields.units: SafetyHead 7-D output, physical units after label_scale

fields.causal_availability: available at t together with the field it annotates
fields.name: current_valid_mask
fields.rationale: without it a dead pixel and a true contact are the same number, and the model would learn to read sensor dropout as an obstacle
fields.units: boolean per pixel; False where the depth reading is below 5 mm

fields.causal_availability: trivially available live as a counter
fields.name: episode_step
fields.rationale: EXCLUDED from model input by choice: on-policy rows all run a fixed 200-step horizon, so a step index lets the model learn a time-indexed prior over when the hazard is near instead of reading it from the proximity field

fields.name: gripper_command
fields.rationale: duplicates nominal_action[7:8]; kept for parity with the live dictionary

fields.name: gripper_state
fields.rationale: duplicates qpos[7:9] but is kept for parity with the live input dictionary

fields.causal_availability: the ACT action for step t, produced before the reference runs
fields.name: nominal_action
fields.rationale: the evaluator computes it first precisely because the reference consumes it
fields.units: radians (7 arm targets) plus 1 gripper command

fields.name: oracle_active
fields.rationale: stratification and metric conditioning only

fields.name: oracle_dq
fields.rationale: the quantity the whole reference exists to estimate

fields.name: parked_closeness
fields.rationale: the primary regression target

fields.name: parked_field_sha256
fields.rationale: provenance only; never an input

fields.name: parked_head
fields.rationale: SafetyHead-space target

fields.name: parked_valid_mask
fields.rationale: target-side validity, used for loss masking and mask-agreement diagnostics

fields.causal_availability: available at t before the control decision
fields.name: qpos
fields.rationale: posture determines which sensors can see the parked hazard at all
fields.units: radians (7 arm joints) and metres (2 finger joints)

fields.causal_availability: available at t before the control decision
fields.name: qvel
fields.rationale: constructed live by the evaluator from obs['qvel']
fields.units: rad/s (7 arm joints) and m/s (2 finger joints)

fields.name: removable_closeness
fields.rationale: the differential the model must reproduce in pixel space

fields.name: scientific_state_sha256
fields.rationale: partition-independence checking

fields.name: state_neutral
fields.rationale: confirms parking perturbed only the hazard

fields.causal_availability: not part of this task's contract
fields.name: teacher_dq
fields.rationale: a previous model's output; using it would make this a distillation task
fields.units: 7-D differential from the previous learner, when populated

fields.causal_availability: not part of this task's contract
fields.name: teacher_valid
fields.rationale: companion flag to teacher_dq

live_evaluator.note: keys parsed from the assignment to `runtime` in the evaluator AST. Matching the largest dict containing qpos instead finds the per-frame diagnostic record, which logs privileged fields and would wrongly certify them live-available.
